title: Interview question sheet with three lines
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: Childhood within living memory (Memory Box)
source: Seeded from history/y1 lesson 4 (Interview question sheet with three lines (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 4: Asking an elder about the past. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Write three questions to ask a family elder on the question sheet.
questions.model: Teacher writes question 1 first: 'What games did you play?'

questions.q: Guess one answer your elder might give.
questions.a: For example: they played marbles outside

questions.q: Write one question about a change.
questions.a: For example: What is different now?
For example: Where did you go to school?
questions.model: Start with 'Where'. Add the idea: go to school. End with a question mark. Where did you go to school?

questions.q: What do we say after the interview?
